headline: When Should I Get My Water Softener Replaced?
articleBody: Knowing the right time to replace your water softener can save you from a lot of headaches and unexpected plumbing issues. If your current system is showing its age, typically beyond 10-15 years, it's a good idea to start thinking about it. You might notice tell-tale signs like your laundry feeling stiff, soap not lathering well, or even persistent mineral buildup on your fixtures – these are all indicators that your softener isn't performing optimally. Another major sign is if your water softener requires frequent, costly repairs. Sometimes, investing in a new, more efficient model can actually save you money on energy and salt consumption in the long run. Don't wait until your system completely breaks down and leaves you with full-blown hard water problems.
